package.description: Local Docker stack manager for PHP development on Windows.

en-US.description: Local Docker stack manager for PHP development on Windows.
en-US.longDescription: WSDD is a Windows desktop application for provisioning and operating local Docker PHP stacks, with Classic Bind, Native Linux, Managed Native Linux, and Fast Sync storage modes, optional ngrok publishing, bundled resources, and environment helpers.
en-US.name: WSDD - WebStack Deployer for Docker
